description: This PHP class defines the Doctrine ORM entity 'ModuleDefaultPage' for the OrangeHRM system. It models the 'ohrm_module_default_page' database table, including properties such as id, action, enableClass, priority, and relationships to UserRole and Module entities. It provides getter and setter methods for each property, representing a domain model relevant to module default page configurations.

classes.name: ModuleDefaultPage
classes.description: Entity class representing default page configurations for modules, with properties mapped to database columns and relationships to UserRole and Module entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action string associated with the default page, nullable.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action string for the default page, nullable.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Returns the enable class string, nullable.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the enable class string, nullable.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the default page configuration.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the default page configuration.
